description:
End a native profiling session started by native-profiler-start and save the trace as a downloadable artifact.
On iOS, export CPU, hangs, and leaks XML from Instruments. Check warning and exportDiagnostics for partial or skipped exports. On Android, save the Perfetto .pftrace.

device_id.description: Target device id from `list-devices` (iOS UDID or Android serial).

name: native-profiler-stop
